title: Keto Polish Mushroom Wrap
description: A keto-friendly twist on traditional polish cuisine, featuring a crunchy mushroom wrap filled with sautéed mushrooms and topped with warm polish cheese.
instructions: Wrap the mushroom wrap in a dry cloth and warm it in the oven for 2 minutes.
Sauté the mushrooms in butter until tender and fragrant.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Place the sautéed mushrooms onto the warmed mushroom wrap.
Top with polish cheese and serve immediately.
